item.description:
Did anyone capture Art On Ice 2026? It was broadcast on Swiss channel 3+ at 9:30 PM on March 25, 2026.

I was told that it may be available online on Zattoo - but I don't have access to that. So if anyone does have access could they maybe capture it for me? I would be extremely grateful.

I'm specifically looking for the parts where Jess Glynne was performing. I found her performances of the songs 'Rather Be' and 'Take Me Home' on YouTube, but I am after her full performance.

Thank You.
